propositions: CI has no lock on complexity-baseline.json against main, unlike the module-size-limit.txt lock at workflows/_build-and-test.yml:363-373, allowing any contributor change to land unreviewed

The baseline can grow silently by adding new entries: the test guards schema and stale entries but does not assert entry count is monotonically non-increasing, so a new high-complexity function can be admitted by adding its baseline entry in the same change
The semantic lock must distinguish legitimate shrinkage (entry removal or ceiling lowered) from illegitimate growth (entry added or ceiling raised), not just byte-equality comparison
The module-size-limit lock fails open on failed git fetch with ::warning::, then runs the cap at unverified $LIMIT from the branch, allowing changes raising the limit to pass if that fetch flakes
The lock must fail closed when the base value cannot be fetched, rejecting any change rather than allowing it to proceed unverified
